news.titleEn: Consumer prices rose 3.7% annually in September as gas prices skyrocket
news.conclusionEn: US CPI rose 0.6% in September for a 3.7% annual rate, with core inflation at 2.6%, both slightly above forecasts as gasoline jumped 9.1%.
news.conclusionZh: 美国9月CPI年增3.7%，核心2.6%，均高于预期
news.whyEn: Hotter inflation all but locks in another Fed rate hike this year, pushing up borrowing costs for consumers, companies and governments worldwide.
news.whyZh: 通胀超预期几乎锁定美联储年内再加息，全球借贷成本承压
news.detailEn: The energy index climbed 5.2% as the Iran war kept oil supply tight, and gasoline alone accounted for about half of the headline increase. Core CPI, which strips out food and energy, rose 0.3% on the month versus 0.2% expected, a sign price pressure is spreading. Futures markets now price a more than 95% chance of at least one more hike before year-end, including roughly 40% odds of a half-point move, after the Fed raised rates in September for the first time in over three years. The S&P 500 fell 1.1% and the Nasdaq 1.9% on the day.
news.detailZh: 受伊朗战争导致的原油供应紧张影响，能源指数上涨5.2%，仅汽油就贡献了约一半的整体涨幅。剔除食品和能源的核心CPI月增0.3%，高于预期的0.2%，说明涨价压力正在扩散。美联储9月已进行三年多来首次加息，期货市场目前认为年内至少再加息一次的概率超过95%，其中加息50个基点的概率约40%。当天标普500下跌1.1%，纳指下跌1.9%。

news.titleEn: CoreWeave shares tumble as bond yields near 15% on concern about AI borrowing binge
news.conclusionEn: CoreWeave stock sank about 15% and its 2032 bonds fell below 80 cents on the dollar, while Oracle dropped nearly 9%, as fears grew over debt-funded AI build-outs.
news.conclusionZh: AI债务担忧发酵，CoreWeave暴跌15%，甲骨文跌近9%
news.whyEn: Bond prices at distressed levels signal credit markets are questioning whether heavily leveraged AI infrastructure players can repay, which could tighten funding for the whole AI boom.
news.whyZh: 债券跌至困境水平，说明信贷市场开始质疑高杠杆AI基建的偿债能力
news.detailEn: CoreWeave's 9.625% notes due 2032 now yield about 14.8%, a level usually associated with financially strained borrowers. The company relies on expensive debt to buy Nvidia chips and on a handful of big customers such as OpenAI, Microsoft and Meta. Oracle's bond yields also rose, and Dell fell 11% on worries about the timing of enterprise AI spending. CEO Mike Intrator said the market was acting 'irrationally' and that the company's backlog more than covers its debt, but rising rates make refinancing costlier.
news.detailZh: CoreWeave 2032年到期、票息9.625%的债券收益率升至约14.8%，通常意味着发行人财务吃紧。该公司依赖高息债务购买英伟达芯片，且收入高度集中于OpenAI、微软、Meta等少数大客户。甲骨文债券收益率同样走高，戴尔也因企业AI支出节奏担忧下跌11%。CEO Mike Intrator称市场「非理性」，并表示订单储备足以覆盖全部债务，但利率上升会让再融资更贵。

news.titleEn: SK Hynix, Samsung, SoftBank stocks: Asia tech rout, AI funding worries
news.conclusionEn: Asian tech stocks slid on Thursday, with SK Hynix down over 8%, Samsung 7.1% and SoftBank 7.9%, tracking Wall Street's AI-led selloff.
news.conclusionZh: 亚洲科技股续挫，SK海力士跌超8%，软银跌7.9%
news.whyEn: Asian chipmakers and AI investors are among the biggest winners of the AI trade, so a rout there shows the funding scare is spreading globally.
news.whyZh: 亚洲芯片股是AI行情最大受益者，暴跌说明融资恐慌正在全球蔓延
news.detailEn: The regional benchmark was on track for a fourth straight daily decline after hot US inflation fuelled bets on more aggressive Fed hikes. Investors fear higher borrowing costs will weigh on the massive capital spending needed to build AI data centers. Japan's Advantest fell 6.9% alongside SoftBank, a major backer of OpenAI. This follows a 7% Korean selloff earlier in the week, raising questions about how much of the AI premium will survive tighter money.
news.detailZh: 美国通胀超预期强化了美联储更激进加息的预期，亚太基准指数有望连续第四天下跌。投资者担心借贷成本上升会拖累建设AI数据中心所需的巨额资本开支。除OpenAI重要投资方软银外，日本芯片测试设备商爱德万也下跌6.9%。本周早些时候韩国股市已暴跌7%，市场开始怀疑在货币收紧环境下AI溢价还能保住多少。

news.titleEn: Aramco Headquarters Struck During Houthi Missile Attacks in Saudi Arabia
news.conclusionEn: A Houthi missile attack hit part of Saudi Aramco's headquarters complex in Dhahran, causing a limited fire, as Brent crude held above $100 a barrel.
news.conclusionZh: 胡塞武装导弹击中沙特阿美总部，油价维持百元上方
news.whyEn: Attacks reaching the world's largest oil company add a new supply risk on top of Iran's tanker strikes near Hormuz, keeping energy prices and inflation elevated.
news.whyZh: 袭击波及全球最大石油公司，叠加霍尔木兹油轮遇袭，推高能源通胀
news.detailEn: Saudi officials said the fire at the Dhahran complex was contained with no injuries, but the strike marked a widening of Houthi attacks on the kingdom. Nine tankers have been attacked in and around the Strait of Hormuz over the past week, with flows through the strait still about 30% below pre-war levels according to Kpler. Saudi production increases had been driving the recent OPEC+ supply recovery, so threats to Saudi infrastructure are especially sensitive. Any disruption to Saudi exports could push oil sharply higher.
news.detailZh: 沙特官方称达兰总部园区的火势已被控制、无人受伤，但这标志着胡塞武装对沙特的袭击范围在扩大。过去一周霍尔木兹海峡及周边已有9艘油轮遇袭，据Kpler数据，海峡通行量仍比战前低约30%。近期OPEC+供应回升主要靠沙特增产，因此沙特基础设施受威胁尤其敏感。一旦沙特出口受阻，油价可能大幅上涨。

news.titleEn: Diesel squeeze set to last well into 2027 as Iran war disrupts supply, IEA says
news.conclusionEn: The IEA's October report warned that oil and diesel supply will stay tight into the second half of 2027 and that renewed Gulf attacks leave the recovery fragile.
news.conclusionZh: IEA警告柴油紧缺将延续至2027年，复苏仍脆弱
news.whyEn: Diesel powers trucking, shipping, farming and factories, so a prolonged shortage feeds directly into freight costs and consumer prices worldwide.
news.whyZh: 柴油驱动运输、农业与工业，长期紧缺会直接推高全球物流和物价
news.detailEn: The International Energy Agency said attacks on Saudi Arabia risk derailing the market recovery that Saudi output gains had been driving. Diesel has been the tightest part of the market because Middle East refineries and exports were disrupted by the war. The report undercuts hopes that a recent US arrangement on Russian diesel would quickly ease fuel prices. For central banks, a long-lasting energy shock makes it harder to bring inflation back to target.
news.detailZh: 国际能源署表示，针对沙特的袭击可能打断此前由沙特增产推动的市场复苏。由于战争冲击了中东炼厂和出口，柴油成为整个油品市场中最紧张的环节。这份报告也削弱了外界对美国近期俄罗斯柴油安排能迅速压低油价的期待。对各国央行来说，能源冲击持续越久，通胀回到目标就越难。

news.titleEn: Bank of America shares drop after third-quarter revenue miss and regulatory penalty
news.conclusionEn: Bank of America earned 91 cents a share versus $1.10 expected, with revenue of $30.12 billion missing forecasts, weighed by weak trading and a $1.2 billion money-laundering fine.
news.conclusionZh: 美银三季度营收逊于预期，叠加12亿美元罚款，股价跌近5%
news.whyEn: As the second-largest US bank, BofA's miss and a record regulatory penalty highlight compliance risk and uneven trading results across Wall Street.
news.whyZh: 美国第二大银行业绩失手且遭创纪录罚款，凸显合规风险
news.detailEn: Quarterly profit fell 17% to $6.93 billion, and fixed income and equities trading together missed estimates by about $750 million. US regulators fined the bank more than $1.21 billion for anti-money-laundering and sanctions violations, including a record $750 million civil penalty from the OCC, saying it had effectively outsourced key compliance work. The shares fell almost 5% on Wednesday. Investors will watch whether the bank needs to spend more on compliance, which could weigh on future margins.
news.detailZh: 季度利润下降17%至69.3亿美元，固定收益和股票交易收入合计比预期少约7.5亿美元。美国监管机构以违反反洗钱和制裁规定为由对其罚款逾12.1亿美元，其中包括美国货币监理署创纪录的7.5亿美元民事罚款，监管称其实际上把关键合规工作「外包」了。周三美银股价下跌近5%。投资者将关注美银是否需要加大合规投入，这可能压低未来利润率。

news.titleEn: Morgan Stanley tops estimates as equities trading revenue beats expectations by $909 million
news.conclusionEn: Morgan Stanley earned $3.03 a share on $20.34 billion in revenue, beating forecasts as equities trading revenue surged 41% to $5.8 billion.
news.conclusionZh: 大摩三季度业绩超预期，股票交易收入大增41%
news.whyEn: The results show volatile markets are a windfall for equity trading desks, though shares still fell about 3% amid the broader selloff.
news.whyZh: 市场波动让股票交易部门大赚，但大盘抛售下股价仍跌约3%
news.detailEn: Analysts surveyed by LSEG had expected $2.91 a share and $19.95 billion in revenue. The bank cited broad strength in equities, with Asia particularly strong. Fixed income trading fell 7% to $2.01 billion, missing estimates, and investment banking revenue rose only 2% to $2.16 billion. The contrast with Bank of America shows how trading performance is diverging across big banks this earnings season.
news.detailZh: LSEG调查的分析师此前预期每股收益2.91美元、营收199.5亿美元。大摩表示股票业务各产品和地区全面走强，其中亚洲尤其亮眼。固定收益交易收入下降7%至20.1亿美元，低于预期；投行收入仅增长2%至21.6亿美元。与美银的对比说明，本轮财报季各大银行的交易业绩明显分化。

news.titleEn: ASML says it's getting order interest through 2030 as profit smashes expectations
news.conclusionEn: ASML reported €11.7 billion in Q3 sales and €5.0 billion in net income, raised its 2026 sales outlook to €44-45 billion and said demand will exceed supply in 2027 and 2028.
news.conclusionZh: ASML利润大超预期，上调全年指引，订单意向排到2030年
news.whyEn: As the sole maker of EUV lithography machines, ASML's outlook is a key read on long-term chip and AI capex, offering a counterpoint to the AI debt scare.
news.whyZh: ASML是EUV光刻机唯一供应商，其展望是芯片与AI长期投资的风向标
news.detailEn: Customers keep raising their short- and medium-term equipment demand forecasts, mainly because of AI investment, and some want to place orders for 2029 and 2030. ASML said its planned supply for 2027 and 2028 will not fully meet demand. Samsung and TSMC committed during the quarter to using its High NA EUV machines, seen as a key future growth driver. The strong outlook contrasts with worries about leveraged AI cloud providers, suggesting chip capacity demand remains firm for now.
news.detailZh: 客户持续上调短中期设备需求预测，主要源于AI投资，部分客户甚至希望下2029和2030年的订单。ASML表示其2027和2028年的计划产能无法完全满足需求。本季度三星和台积电都承诺采用其High NA EUV光刻机，这被视为未来增长的关键。强劲展望与市场对高杠杆AI云厂商的担忧形成对比，说明芯片产能需求目前依然稳固。

news.titleEn: China PPI rise fastest since June 2022 on fuel costs
news.conclusionEn: China's producer price index rose 5% year on year in September, its fastest pace in over four years and above the 4.5% forecast, driven by higher fuel costs.
news.conclusionZh: 中国9月PPI同比上涨5%，创四年多最快涨幅
news.whyEn: Rising factory-gate prices in the world's biggest manufacturer could push up the cost of Chinese exports and add to global inflation pressure.
news.whyZh: 全球最大制造国出厂价走高，可能推高出口成本、加剧全球通胀
news.detailEn: PPI accelerated from 3.8% in August, reflecting the pass-through of oil prices lifted by the Iran war. Gasoline prices in China climbed 16.6% from a year earlier. After years of factory-gate deflation, the turn to strong producer inflation squeezes manufacturers' margins if they cannot pass costs on. It also complicates Beijing's policy choices as it tries to support growth.
news.detailZh: PPI涨幅较8月的3.8%进一步加快，反映出伊朗战争推高的油价正在向下游传导。中国汽油价格同比上涨16.6%。在经历多年出厂价格通缩之后，生产端通胀快速抬头，若企业无法转嫁成本，利润率将受挤压。这也让北京在稳增长时的政策选择更加复杂。

news.titleEn: 'Massive' Russian attack on Ukraine kills at least 9, damages power sites
news.conclusionEn: A large Russian strike on Ukraine's energy grid killed at least nine people and left about 600,000 without power, days after Trump announced an 'energy ceasefire'.
news.conclusionZh: 俄大规模袭击乌能源设施致9死，特朗普「能源停火」受挫
news.whyEn: The attack undercuts Washington's truce effort, while Ukraine also reported sudden Starlink restrictions, raising doubts about Western support and energy-market stability.
news.whyZh: 袭击打击美方停火努力，叠加星链受限，西方支持与能源稳定存疑
news.detailEn: Ballistic missiles hit energy infrastructure in the Kyiv and Kharkiv regions, targets that were supposed to be covered by the ceasefire. President Zelenskyy called the strike deliberate and demonstrative, saying Russia had never shown such open disrespect toward the United States. Separately, Ukraine said SpaceX had throttled Starlink terminals in motion without warning; Elon Musk said such limits are decided by the US military. Washington has also warned it could cut intelligence sharing unless Kyiv stops long-range drone strikes on Russian refineries.
news.detailZh: 弹道导弹击中基辅和哈尔科夫地区的能源设施，而这些本应受停火协议保护。泽连斯基称此次袭击是蓄意的示威，俄罗斯从未如此公然藐视美国。另外，乌克兰称SpaceX未经通知限制了移动中星链终端的网速，马斯克则表示相关限制由美军决定。美方还警告，如果基辅不停止对俄炼油厂的远程无人机袭击，可能切断情报共享。

businessTips.explanationEn: Customer concentration risk arises when a large share of a company's revenue comes from just a few customers. If one of them cuts orders, renegotiates prices or goes elsewhere, revenue can drop sharply overnight. A common rule of thumb is that any single customer above 10% of revenue, or the top five above 50%, deserves close attention. Investors and acquirers often discount the value of concentrated businesses because their cash flows are less predictable.
businessTips.explanationZh: 客户集中度风险是指公司大部分收入来自少数几个客户。一旦其中某个客户削减订单、压价或转投他家，收入可能一夜之间大幅下滑。常见的经验标准是：单一客户占收入超过10%，或前五大客户合计超过50%，就需要重点关注。投资人和收购方通常会给高度集中的企业打折估值，因为其现金流更难预测。
businessTips.exampleEn: CoreWeave relies on a handful of giants like OpenAI, Microsoft and Meta for most of its revenue, which is one reason its bonds sold off so hard. A small agency can reduce this risk by capping any one client at around 25% of revenue and steadily adding smaller accounts.
businessTips.exampleZh: CoreWeave的大部分收入来自OpenAI、微软、Meta等少数巨头，这也是其债券遭重挫的原因之一。小型代理公司可以把单一客户收入占比控制在25%左右，并持续开发中小客户，以降低这种风险。

businessTips.explanationEn: Retainer pricing means a client pays a fixed fee every month for ongoing access to your services, rather than paying per project or per hour. It turns lumpy freelance income into predictable recurring revenue and reduces time spent constantly selling new projects. Clients like it because they get priority access and a known budget. The key is to define the scope clearly, such as hours, deliverables or response times, so the retainer doesn't turn into unlimited work.
businessTips.explanationZh: 包月服务费（Retainer）是指客户每月支付固定费用，持续获得你的服务，而不是按项目或按小时付费。它能把起伏不定的自由职业收入变成可预测的经常性收入，也减少了不断找新项目的时间。客户喜欢它，因为能获得优先服务且预算可控。关键是要明确服务范围，比如时长、交付物或响应时间，避免包月变成无限量干活。
businessTips.exampleEn: A freelance bookkeeper who used to charge per job could offer a $400-a-month package covering monthly reconciliation, a short report and two hours of questions. With ten such clients, they start each month with $4,000 already secured.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位以前按次收费的自由职业记账员，可以推出每月400美元的套餐，包含月度对账、一份简报和两小时答疑。只要有十个这样的客户，每个月一开始就已锁定4000美元收入。

businessTips.explanationEn: Yield to maturity (YTM) is the total annual return a bond buyer earns if they hold it until it matures and the issuer pays everything as promised. When a bond's price falls, its YTM rises, because the buyer pays less for the same coupons and principal. Bonds trading below about 80 cents on the dollar, or yielding roughly 10 percentage points above Treasuries, are generally considered distressed, meaning the market sees a real risk of default. A very high yield is therefore usually a warning sign, not a free lunch.
businessTips.explanationZh: 到期收益率（YTM）是指投资者持有债券到期、且发行人按约定全额支付时，每年获得的总回报率。债券价格下跌，YTM就会上升，因为同样的票息和本金用更低价格就能买到。价格跌破面值约80%、或收益率比国债高出约10个百分点的债券，通常被视为「困境债券」，意味着市场认为违约风险真实存在。因此，极高的收益率通常是警示信号，而不是白捡的便宜。
businessTips.exampleEn: CoreWeave's 9.625% bond due 2032 now yields about 14.8% because its price fell below 80 cents. A buyer would earn that only if CoreWeave pays in full; if it restructures, investors might recover much less.
businessTips.exampleZh: CoreWeave 2032年到期、票息9.625%的债券，因价格跌破80美分，到期收益率升至约14.8%。但只有在CoreWeave全额偿付时买家才能拿到这个回报；如果公司债务重组，投资者可能收回得少得多。
